findings.claim: The new theme hash check misses implementation remediation after gate rejection.
findings.evidence: The amendment places recomputation "at design_generation and again at the start of implement". However, modules/gate-protocol.md:176–178 handles SpecKit remediation by "Re-invoke the relevant SpecKit skill via the Skill tool", without re-executing the implement phase block. A theme edited while gate_implement is rejected can therefore reach regenerated code without the promised rescan and user decision. The section 3 change list also omits gate-protocol.md.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the plan to require the same theme verification and implementation UI arguments before SpecKit implementation remediation in gate-protocol.md, referencing one canonical procedure rather than duplicating its rules.
